laws.rule: Climbing to Hallasan's summit (Baengnokdam) needs an advance booking on the official Hallasan reservation system for the Seongpanak and Gwaneumsa trails; daily quotas are 1,000 on Seongpanak and 500 on Gwaneumsa.
laws.heading: 한라산탐방 예약시스템 (Hallasan trail reservation)

sources.title: 한라산탐방 예약시스템
sources.authority: Hallasan National Park, Jeju Special Self-Governing Province

local-law.note: Lower trail sections need no booking.
